title: Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II)
location_or_scope: Investigation landing page; Version 4; file inventory
audit_notes: NASA says BASS-II varied forced-flow speed/direction, oxygen, and sample geometry; flame spread rates determined in concurrent and opposed flow. PSI listing shows 694 files, but this audit did not retrieve individual numerical source files.

title: Effects of Confinement on Opposed-Flow Flame Spread over Cellulose and Polymeric Solids in Microgravity
source_type: Peer-reviewed journal article; Microgravity Science and Technology 36, 20 (2024)
audit_notes: Reports ISS opposed-flow tests for SIBAL and PMMA; flow 2.6–10.5 cm/s, confinement H=1–2 cm; compares BASS duct height H=3.8 cm and reports qualitative/percentage comparisons. Does not by itself supply the Figure 10 point-level BASS metadata.
